bullets: Changed: In full screen, this bell sits next to the TMS name at the top left and stays there.
Changed: The Dev Update bell now lives in full screen only, right of the tracker name at the top left. It is gone from the side pane.
Changed: A red dot on the bell means something new. Nothing pops up any more: click the bell to read it, and the dot clears.
Changed: You can still drag the bell away; drop it near its spot and it goes back.
Changed: The sun and moon on the light/dark button are whole again.
Changed: The Dev Update bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.
Changed: Light/dark shows half of each symbol with a slash between them.
Changed: Refresh, full screen and light/dark mode are now icons at the top right of each page, with this bell right after them. Point at an icon to see what it does.
New: Light/dark shows sun / moon. The one on the right is the mode you switch to, and they swap places when you press it.
Changed: The tracker shows a short loading screen while it reads the workbook, then asks you to "Enter your name". Anyone can be using it, not just the tech at the chair.
Changed: On the name screen your names sit under the heading with more room, and a long list scrolls instead of being cut off.

New: during the session, tick LumaPay card on file and the patient's verbal consent to collect the copay at time of service. It's on today's visit in the patient view and in Complete session, saved to the visit's Notes with your name and the time.
New: once a day the tracker asks who is using it, from this workbook's own list. Pick your name or add yourself. It fills in Treating technician and signs the Edit log.
The clinic is never assumed. It comes from Settings or the workbook's name, and once saved only an admin can change it.
New: the bell in the top right lists what changed in the tracker. A note like this one appears once after each update.
Banners you dismiss or snooze stay hidden when you switch between the task pane and full screen.
